text:
sara: Support ticket: customer on mobile SDK observed two toolcall charges for one user action after a 504 + client retry. Small amount but annoying.
jon: can you paste the snippet from the gateway logs?
sara: yup, sanitized: ```
CLIENT_CALL id=tx-9 tool=search_tool session=sess-77 sdk=ios v=2.1.3 -> upstream-> gateway node A
GATEWAY A -> TOOLSERVICE idempotency_key=null call_id=tx-9 status=202 accepted provisional=false tokens=12
...client gets 504 and retries...
CLIENT_CALL id=tx-9 tool=search_tool session=sess-77 sdk=ios v=2.1.3 -> gateway node B
GATEWAY B -> TOOLSERVICE call_id=tx-9 idempotency_key=null status=200 confirmed tokens=12
```
rachel: so node A forwarded and it was accepted but we returned 504 before confirmation, node B retried and got a confirmed result. We ended up with 2 confirmed ledger entries (one from A, one from B) because we don't check dedupe on call_id.
vikas: why did A write a ledger row if it never got a confirmed response? Shouldn't provisional writes be marked provisional=true?
jon: our current flow: gateway forwards request, toolservice returns status; we write confirmed ledger on 200. Node A got a 202 (accepted) but the gateway still wrote a confirmed row due to a bug in the error path. Oops.
sara: customer-facing: they saw two small charges (same token amount) and opened a ticket.
rachel: short-term mitigation: treat 202/accepted writes as provisional only. Then when a 200 comes in, confirm and dedupe by `call_id` if present.
vikas: long-term we should require an idempotency header on all tool calls (X-Tool-Idempotency) and reject otherwise (or generate server-side idempotency and return it). That makes dedupe reliable across gateways.
jon: agree. Also add server-side check: when writing confirmed ledger row, check if there's an existing confirmed row with same call_id/tool/session and skip double-write. We'll need an index on (call_id, tool).
sara: Console UX: how do we surface this to customers? currently they see two lines and blame us. Could merge duplicates in UI if they have same call_id and close timestamps within N seconds.
rachel: but Console merge can hide real distinct calls with same call_id if clients are buggy. Safer to show merged view with an "expanded" section that shows both low-level events. Default to merged for billing view, expanded for audit.
vikas: telemetry: emit metric `toolcall.duplicate_confirmed.count` with tags tool=<tool>, sdk=<sdk>, gateway_node=<node> and a counter for dedupe_skipped. Also histogram for time_between_dupes.
jon: ops-bot: Please note down a runbook item: if duplicate-confirmed spikes > 5/min for any tool, page oncall.
ops-bot: RUNBOOK ENTRY CREATED: "duplicate toolcall confirmed -> page oncall if rate>5/min".
sara: rollout plan: 1) stop writing confirmed for 202 paths (hotfix) 2) add call_id dedupe in ledger (DB migration, index) 3) require/accept X-Tool-Idempotency with SDK patch 4) Console merge UX + docs change. Gate steps 2-4 behind feature flag.
rachel: DB migration question: adding a unique index on (call_id, tool) for confirmed rows will fail if dupes already exist. We'll need a cleanup job to dedupe historical rows first.
vikas: yep — create a backfill that finds groups by (call_id, tool) and marks all but earliest confirmed as `reconciled_duplicate=true` and link them to canonical_row_id.\on: who will own the backfill?
sara: I'll pick it up. Will open PRs for hotfix + migration + backfill.
jon: one more thought: some clients don't set call_id. For those, server-generated idempotency can be returned in response header in future, but we should not silently auto-dedupe those without explicit key.
rachel: Docs: update SDK guide to strongly encourage using X-Tool-Idempotency and explain how retries are handled. Billing FAQ note: small duplicate charges may be visible briefly while we roll out dedupe.
sara: created draft issue #4421 with the plan and estimates. Will ping @vikas and @jon on PRs.
vikas: cool. For canary, let's enable dedupe on internal tools first (search_tool, embed_batch) and monitor metric.
jon: sounds good. I'll add alert and dashboard panel showing duplicate_confirmed.count and the reconciliation backlog.
sara: thanks all. I'll post status updates in this thread as I push PRs.
ops-bot: NOTE: customer ticket #9982 updated: suspect duplicate confirmed toolcall; ops team notified.
